text:
mina_partnerships: Quick thread — proposing a Marketplace private offer with HW partner PulseCompute + SI enable bundle. Need alignment on tiering, cross-region credits, renewal cadence, and press embargo.

juan_sales: Nice. Customer wants 18mo with appliance option. Recommend three tiers: 200k / 800k / 2.5M. Discounts: 9% / 18% / 27%. For top tier include a HW-credit equal to 6% of contract value, paid as appliance hours.

tara_ops: Ops checklist: marketplace metadata, support runbook, enablement webinar. Launch phases: partners-only + private listing (T), partner webinar (T+4), public blog + press (T+21). Need legal-approved case study copy before T+7.

oliver_finance: Margin floor 57%. If prepaid for 18mo give extra 3% discount. Require 25% non-refundable deposit for >800k. Cross-region convert: allow unused commit to convert to region-specific reserved credits but cap at 30% of unused value. Include year-end true-up.

keiko_si: SI asks: 4% co-sell credit on committed spend, $15k enablement credit for partners that hit first invoice within 60 days, and explicit 45/90/120 enablement timeline in PO. Need an opt-in clause for joint case study.

launchbot: private-offer-draft created: /marketplace/drafts/pulse-appliance-si-bundle-299001 (creator: mina_partnerships)

mina_partnerships: two quick product asks: (1) SKU naming conventions — should token vs appliance hours be separate SKUs? (2) Fallback: if appliance delays exceed 30 days, allow temporary hosted usage at committed price with capped uplift and auto-credit reconciliation.

juan_sales: Keep SKUs separate. Draft SKU map: `pulse_commit_200k`, `pulse_commit_800k`, `pulse_commit_2_5m`, `pulse_appliance_hours_credit`. I'll drop a short term-sheet.

oliver_finance: I'll run margin sims and confirm HW-credit cap (suggest $175k) by EOD. Also recommend rev-rec guard rails and audit rights for consumption reporting.

tara_ops: I'll own marketplace listing + webinar logistics. Can someone volunteer PR owner (need embargo date)?

mina_partnerships: happy to coordinate PR with marketing; prefer a soft embargo until we have first 3 customers onboarded. Scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 8:30am PT to finalize terms.

keiko_si: Onboarding SLA: 45 days for small deals, 30 days for enterprise. We'll draft enablement SOW.

juan_sales: link to doc: https://redwood.internal/partners/pulse-term-sheet-draft (WIP). RSVP for 8:30am.

launchbot: calendar invite sent: pulse-private-offer-sync 8:30am PT

mina_partnerships: thanks all, see you tomorrow — agenda: commit bands, HW kicker mechanics, cross-region convert caps, announcement cadence.
